annotations.title: Solana SPL Token Mint/Freeze Authority & Rug-Pull Risk Evaluator

description: Evaluates Solana SPL and Token-2022 rug-pull risk by checking mint/freeze authorities, permanent delegates, transfer hooks, and returning reason codes with slot height. Use when making a pre-trade security decision on whether an SPL or Token-2022 mint is safe to trade; for DEX liquidity and metadata lookup via x402, use inspect_solana_token_liquidity instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'token_address' ('risk_profile' defaults to 'strict_decentralized'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (20 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

risk_profile.description: Tolerance policy for centralized freeze authorities; defaults to 'strict_decentralized' when omitted.

token_address.description: Base58-encoded Solana SPL token mint address (32–44 characters).

name: evaluate_solana_token_risk

freeze_authority_present.description: True if an active authority can freeze holder token accounts.

reason_codes.description: Programmatic risk verdicts and reason codes (e.g. REGULATED_STABLECOIN_FREEZE_AUTHORITY, TOKEN_2022_PERMANENT_DELEGATE).

risk_score.description: Rug-pull risk score from 0.0 (renounced/safe) to 1.0 (critical danger).

should_transact.description: True when the token passes authority and concentration safety checks.

slot.description: Solana block slot at which the on-chain mint and authority state was verified.

token_2022_extensions.description: Detected Token-2022 extensions including permanent delegate, transfer hook, default frozen, and transfer fees.

default_account_frozen.description: True if new token accounts are initialized in frozen state by default.

permanent_delegate_present.description: True if a Token-2022 permanent delegate can arbitrarily transfer or burn holder tokens.

transfer_fee_active.description: True if transfer fee extension withholds tokens on transfer.

transfer_hook_present.description: True if an external transfer hook program executes on every transfer.

token_standard.description: Identified Solana token program standard ('spl-token', 'token-2022', or 'native-sol').

valid_base58.description: True when the provided address is a valid Base58 Solana public key.
